import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.1f')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Physical Activity Level'], s=100, cmap='coolwarm', edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity Level')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel')[:len(bmi_counts)]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_pie, explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 4. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_steps = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('mako', len(occupation_steps))
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_steps.index, occupation_steps.values, color=colors)
ax4.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation')
ax4.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.0f')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors_bar = ['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62']
bars = ax5.bar(disorder_counts.index, disorder_counts.values, color=colors_bar[:len(disorder_counts)], edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')
ax5.bar_label(bars)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
disorder_colors = {'None': '#2ecc71', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax6.scatter(subset['Heart Rate'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=disorder, s=100, c=disorder_colors.get(disorder, 'gray'), 
                edgecolors='black', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax6.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Sleep Quality by Disorder')
ax6.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
